Arsenal Draws with Newcastle, Raya Injured

Arsenal was held to a 2-2 draw by Newcastle in a match where neither team could secure a late winning goal. The draw brought Arsenal's point total to 28, placing them six points ahead of Brighton & Hove Albion. Goalkeeper David Raya sustained an injury during the game. Newcastle player Bruno Guimaraes commented on his frustration after being booed during the match.
